import sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import Job, find_deficient_cut, compile_plan, check_plan

def bench(name, n, m, k, dem, p, rate, seed=3):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    used=set(); links=[]
    while len(links)<m:
        u=rng.randrange(n); v=rng.randrange(n)
        if u==v: continue
        kk=(min(u,v),max(u,v))
        if kk in used: continue
        used.add(kk); links.append((u,v,rng.randint(1,10**12)))
    ps=rng.sample(range(n), k)
    demands={v: dem for v in ps}
    env={l: rate for l in range(m)}
    job=Job(n,links,demands,p,env)
    t0=time.monotonic(); cut=find_deficient_cut(job); tc=time.monotonic()-t0
    if cut is not None:
        print(f'{name}: denied by cut ({tc:.2f}s)')
        return
    t0=time.monotonic(); plan=compile_plan(job, budget=40); dt=time.monotonic()-t0
    ok = plan is not None and check_plan(job,plan)
    print(f'{name}: ok={ok} tcut={tc:.2f} tplan={dt:.2f} trees={len(plan["trees"]) if plan else "-"} routes={len(plan["routes"]) if plan else "-"} recipes={len(plan["recipes"]) if plan else "-"}')

bench('dense32 generous', 48, 128, 32, 10**6, 10**6, 10**6)
bench('sparse32 generous', 48, 60, 32, 10**6, 1, 4*10**6)
bench('dense16 huge dem', 40, 100, 16, 10**12, 10**6, 10**12)
bench('sparse8 tight', 20, 30, 8, 10**3, 1, 3000, seed=11)
bench('ring32 exact', 32, 32, 32, 1, 1, 16)
bench('32part 64links', 48, 64, 32, 10**4, 2, 40000, seed=21)
bench('all 48 participants', 48, 128, 32, 10**6, 1, 10**6, seed=31)
PY
